en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside panorama of a town with low, traditional buildings along both banks of a wide river. A bridge crosses the river in the middle distance. In the foreground is a riverside promenade with a few people and a horse-drawn cart. French caption text appears along the top, and there is a handwritten word near the center. A logo and website watermark (elia.org.gr) are printed at the lower right.
